_comment: The fog ambush rule, measured (DERIVATION 38). Fixture: savestate slot 2
with fog written on (0x0300431D = 1); P1's Mech #3 real-moved (7,6)->(6,7)
on P1's turn; P2's Tank 71 at (9,7) typed APC (RAM 7, vision 1) before
P2's turn so the Mech three tiles west is UNLIT at P2's turn start (the
game's vision array read 0 at (6,7) and (7,7)). Row y=7 is road from
x=1 to x=13; (5,7) is reachable only through (6,7) (mountains north and
south of it). The APC's move is 6.
grid rows are the game's own move-select grid at [0x03003600+y*4][x]
(cost spent, 255 unreachable), x = 0..14, read with the APC selected.
PCs on the trapped move: fuel 0x080241A0, position 0x08026076/7C, acted
0x0802609C -- the ordinary move applier, with the path cut short.

grid.reading: a hidden enemy's tile is marked reachable at its path cost (3) but the fill does not expand out of it -- (5,7) stays 255 under fog exactly as with the Mech visible, where (6,7) itself is 255

drives.note: normal move short of the Mech; Wait picked from the menu

Trap: stops on the tile before the hidden unit, fuel charged for the two tiles travelled, action spent with no menu; the Mech is lit afterwards (the mover's own vision 1 reaches it -- a separate reveal rule is not distinguishable here)
confirm refused: (5,7) is 255 in the grid (only route is through the Mech)
